notes: Neutral-only CO2/MEA/H2O parameter set for the reviewer-response thermodynamic sensitivity lane.
These values intentionally exclude ions and reaction products. They are not a full electrolyte-reactive ePC-SAFT model.
Pure-component parameters are taken from Table 2 of Baygi and Pahlavanzadeh (2015).
The selected neutral-comparison association schemes follow that paper's ternary CO2-MEA-H2O calculation: nonassociating CO2, 3B MEA, and 4C water.
Binary interaction parameters follow the paper's ternary setup: CO2-MEA and CO2-H2O are predictive with k_ij = 0, and MEA-H2O uses k_ij = -0.0520 from the 3B MEA / 4C water binary VLE fit.
